subject: world_language
concept: Using idiomatic and nuanced vocabulary fluently and appropriately in context
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR C1 'wide range of vocabulary, idiom, and colloquialism' descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a nuanced vocabulary choice to the subtle shade of meaning it conveys versus a simpler synonym
exercise.abstract: Student selects the most nuanced, contextually appropriate word choice among several close synonyms

misconception_flags: treats near-synonyms as fully interchangeable regardless of subtle contextual differences

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
